paper.title: Constrained Multi-Objective Wind Farm Layout Optimization: Novel Constraint Handling Approach Based on Constraint Programming

author_assets.paper_implementation: in-house C++ NSGA-II plus proprietary IBM ILOG CP Optimizer 12.6 C++ interface
author_assets.public_source_status: no author implementation or native map arrays located
author_assets.native_map_status: nine polygon maps, receptors, random states, and raw fronts unavailable

paper_source_conflicts.paper: printed Eqs. 1, 3, and 4 mix half-deficit and full-deficit induction conventions
Eq. 20 compares every repaired turbine against starred current coordinates even when several infeasible turbines are repaired together
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: joint repaired-variable spacing constraints; fixed feasible turbines retain current coordinates

paper_source_conflicts.paper: AEP is maximized but printed Eq. 17 adds a positive violation penalty
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: minimize negative AEP plus the positive dynamic penalty

paper_source_conflicts.paper: the CP objective is evaluated after variables are discretized to 150 bins but the unit is not explicitly restated
paper_source_conflicts.resolution: squared discrete-bin coordinates; interpreting 50/100 as m2 makes the paper's reported 10-48 percent repair rates unattainable

missing_information: author C++ implementation and IBM CP model state
nine native random convex-polygon maps and receptor coordinates
penalty coefficients in the target paper
NSGA-II SBX and polynomial-mutation distribution indices

completion_decisions: Reconstruct nine deterministic similar-area jittered-Voronoi maps with one receptor at each forbidden seed.
Use the cited Kusiak direction probabilities and Weibull scales to reconstruct 24 directions by 43 speed bins.
Use the predecessor paper's 1e4 and 4e4 penalty coefficients and 1.5 m receptor height.
Use Deb-standard distribution indices eta_c=20 and eta_m=20.
Use 20 C, 80 percent humidity, 101325 Pa, and soft ground as declared ISO 9613 completions cross-checked against pinned PyWake.
Replace proprietary IBM CP with deterministic feasibility-first joint discrete branch-and-bound over the 150-bin grid, retaining the ten-second upper bound.
Bound the open replacement to 4096 nearest legal candidates per repaired turbine and a 2000-node deterministic fallback; expose every node-limit event.
Parallelize repair, wind/noise evaluation, dominance construction, offspring creation, and independent paper runs without nested oversubscription.

domain.map_generator: 15 by 15 jittered seed lattice and clipped Voronoi cells
domain.restricted_area_semantics: select whole reconstructed convex cells until sampled available area is nearest the target
domain.receptor_semantics: one receptor at the generating seed of every forbidden cell

wind.conditional_distribution: Weibull shape 2 with paper-lineage direction scales; each direction is renormalized over the retained speed bins

wake.objective: maximize expected annual energy in GWh

noise.model: ISO 9613-1 atmospheric and ISO 9613-2 divergence/ground propagation
noise.objective: minimize maximum expected A-weighted SPL over receptors

constraints.regulatory: every turbine must lie in an available reconstructed polygon
constraints.violation: sum of spacing deficits and sampled distance to available land

chcp.objective: minimize the sum of squared repaired-minus-current discrete coordinate indices
chcp.production_replacement: deterministic greedy incumbents plus bounded joint branch-and-bound

nsga2.convergence: rank-one crowding-distance variance below 0.005 for the last 100 generations

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete AEP, maximum-SPL, and constraint evaluation of one physical layout
physical_fes_ledger.repair: does not consume physical wind-farm FES
physical_fes_ledger.dominance_and_variation: do not consume physical wind-farm FES
physical_fes_ledger.terminal_partial_work: the final offspring prefix exactly fills the requested physical-FES budget

hpc_execution.single_run: persistent workers partition CHCP repairs, physical evaluations, offspring creation, and pairwise dominance work
hpc_execution.multi_run: independent paper runs are distributed over all requested workers; workers per run are floor(total_workers/run_parallelism)
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: counter-keyed random events and fixed-index commits make scientific output independent of worker count
hpc_execution.timing: CHCP repair, physical evaluator, algorithm-only, preprocessing, and end-to-end wall time are reported separately

claim_boundary: academic declared flexible reproduction of the paper problem and target CHCP-NSGA-II method; not author code, proprietary IBM CP behavior, native maps, native random states, or exact numerical replay
